notes: KB Fellowship at NIAS is a residual individual fellowship: fellows pursue their own independent research for five months at the Netherlands Institute for Advanced Study with no supervisory structure. Official page (nias.knaw.nl) lists only an administrative contact, Robert Raub, Partnership Officer (partners@nias.knaw.nl); selection is by a ranking committee appointed by the KB and the NIAS Fellowship Advisory Committee. No supervising professor is attached to the fellowship by design, so not_applicable.

Willem F. Duisenberg Fellowship at NIAS is a residual individual fellowship in economics: the fellow pursues their own work in applied monetary economics, macroeconomics or public finance at the institute with no supervisory structure. Official page (nias.knaw.nl) lists only an administrative contact, Robert Raub, Partnership Officer (partners@nias.knaw.nl); selection is by the Board of the Willem F. Duisenberg Fellowship Foundation in consultation with the NIAS Director. No supervising professor attached, so not_applicable.

Eric Bleumink Fellowship is a university-level financial grant at the University of Groningen. Official page states it cannot be actively applied for: 'The University of Groningen Admission Office, in consultation with the Admission Boards of its faculties, will determine which applicants will be nominated'. No faculty member, supervisor or programme contact is tied to the award, so not_applicable.

notes: The KITLV Visiting Fellowship itself is an independent, self-directed three-month research stay (fellows work on a project of their own choice and need no host affiliation), so there is no formal PhD supervision. The only named faculty tie in the official call is the Program Chair, Prof. Ward Berenschot, whose KITLV profile is institutional (kitlv.nl) and publishes his email berenschot@kitlv.nl on that page, verified here. He is Program Chair and addressee of the fellowship applications, not a project supervisor.

Tilburg University Waiver (DEI) is a 50% institutional tuition-fee reduction allocated by random lottery among eligible admitted applicants. Official page describes an administrative process only (waiver webform, Admissions, general contact form); no supervising professor or programme faculty is attached to the waiver, so not_applicable.

Radboud Scholarship Programme is a merit-based partial tuition scholarship decided by faculty selection committees and department Student Life and International Mobility. Official page names no professors or supervisors; contact is the generic scholarships@ru.nl. No faculty tie attached to the award, so not_applicable.

Erasmus University Rotterdam Scholarships (Erasmus Trustfonds, Trustfonds + TSH Changemaker, FUNED) are university-level financial awards administered via the International Office and participating schools. The official scholarship pages (eur.nl; the batch URL /en/education/masters-programmes/scholarships now redirects/404s, current hub: /en/education/practical-matters/scholarships-grants/students-coming-rotterdam and /en/scholarship/erasmus-trustfonds-scholarship) list only the generic contact scholarships@eur.nl and per-school application pages; no named professors or supervisors, so not_applicable.
